attacks.claim: Migration 0042 runs in-place against production and drops positions.roll_history in the same transaction, with no backup, snapshot, or rollback step. Only the last 90 days are backfilled, so older roll history is permanently lost. The plan also keeps roll_eod.py as a fallback through week 4, but the artifact never says that script stops reading roll_history, so the fallback may break the moment the column is gone.
attacks.evidence: "In the same transaction, ALTER TABLE positions DROP COLUMN roll_history." / "Backfill copies roll_history entries from the last 90 days into rolls; older entries are not needed" / ABSENT: pre-migration backup, restore procedure, and confirmation that roll_eod.py does not depend on roll_history.
